records.name: Milky Cannon
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Captain Ginyu mentor training, Lesson 2. The projectile travels quickly at first, then slows and remains in the air for roughly three seconds; charging changes the point where it transitions to the slower movement. Current skill documentation reports a single hit, knockback, and about 10% damage.

records.name: Side Bridge
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ39. Throws a green Ki disc straight ahead; after traveling outward it returns to the user like a boomerang, producing a two-hit/re-stand interaction. Current skill documentation reports 15% total damage. Exact startup and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Dragon Fist
records.mechanics_notes: 500-Ki Strike Ultimate sold through the TP Medal Shop. The user kicks and punches the opponent, then a Shenron image pierces the target; current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation records 14 hits and about 50% total damage. It can miss if the setup is interrupted or the follow-up is avoided, so exact frame data remains unresolved.

records.name: Psycho Barrier
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Bojack mentor Lesson 2. Creates a protective green barrier in front of the user; additional input expands the barrier up to two times and each contact is reported at about 2% damage. Current evidence supports both defensive protection and offensive contact, while exact duration/frame behavior remains unresolved.

records.name: Death Psycho Bomb
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ33. Places a telekinetic trap at the opponent's movement path; on contact it grabs and lifts the target before an explosion. After a knockback it can be positioned in the opponent's flight path. Exact damage and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Double Death Slicer
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ24. Throws two Death Slicer discs; repeat input can make the discs track the opponent, with up to five repeat inputs. Current skill documentation reports each hit at 10% damage and warns that the attack cannot be guarded. Exact input timing and hit-count outcomes remain unresolved.

records.name: Kill Driver
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Turles mentor training. Creates and throws a ring-shaped Ki projectile; charging increases its size and power. The hollow center can allow a small or well-positioned opponent to pass through, while additional input can detonate the ring to cover that weakness. Exact charge scaling and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Scatter Kamehameha
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned from Krillin mentor Lesson 3. Fires a straight beam that transitions into a rain of tracking Ki blasts; current skill documentation reports 8 hits and about 30% total damage. The hit can lock the opponent in an animation, preventing an Evasive or Limit Burst during the sequence. Exact startup and frame data remain unresolved.
